inputs.text: Rubenstein is right that a political resolution matters, but peace cannot rest on asking Israel to abandon a firm stance while an operation is ongoing. A government’s first duty is to protect its people and preserve order; treating security measures as the cause of the danger risks excusing those who threaten it. Rights matter, but so do public safety and the stability families need. Any lasting settlement has to take those responsibilities seriously, not make restraint by one side the whole plan.

output.main_topic: Political resolution and security responsibilities during an ongoing operation
